title: The Velvet Alibi
blurb: A crooked promoter claims he spent all night sipping bourbon at the Blue Note, but the body at the rain-soaked docks tells another story.
setting: A dim interrogation chamber at precinct 4. Rain lashes the frosted window. A single incandescent bulb swings above a scarred metal desk.
briefing: At 11:45 PM last night, notorious loan shark Frankie 'Two-Tone' Morretti was executed in an alleyway by the North Docks. Witness reports place a luxury sedan fleeing the scene. Your suspect is Vincent 'Silky' Vance, a club promoter in heavy debt to Morretti. Vance claims he never set foot outside the Blue Note Jazz Lounge all night.

suspect.name: Vincent 'Silky' Vance
suspect.personality: Smooth-talking, condescending, defensive under scrutiny, quick to deflect with swagger until cornered.
suspect.speech_style: 1940s noir slang, dismissive tone, refers to the detective as 'flatfoot' or 'detective', feigns aristocratic charm.

truth_sheet.what_really_happened: Vincent Vance was drowned in debt to Frankie Morretti. At 11:10 PM, he slipped out of the Blue Note fire exit, drove his Packard to the docks, shot Morretti at 11:45 PM with an unregistered .38 revolver, scrambled across greasy crane rails, and returned through the jazz club's kitchen at 12:30 AM.
timeline: 10:15 PM: Vance arrives at the Blue Note Jazz Lounge.
10:45 PM: Vance orders drinks and pays bar tab with his credit card.
11:10 PM: Vance slips out the side alley door into the rain.
11:45 PM: Morretti shot at point-blank range near dock crane #4.
12:30 AM: Vance sneaks back into the Blue Note through the kitchen alley.
02:00 AM: Blue Note closes; Vance departs.
truth_sheet.secret: Vance killed Morretti to wipe out his $50,000 gambling marker. He stained his silk cuff with dock machinery grease while climbing down the crane pier.

cover_story: I was at the Blue Note Jazz Lounge from 10:00 PM until closing at 2:00 AM. I never left Booth Four for even a minute. I listened to Delilah sing three sets, paid everything in green cash like a gentleman, and don't know a thing about Frankie Morretti or the docks.

evidence.name: Blue Note Bar Tab
evidence.description: Receipt from the Blue Note timestamped 10:45 PM. Paid via card ending in 4102 with Vincent Vance's signature, showing a $120 tab.

evidence.name: Waitstaff Logbook
evidence.description: Floor manager notes for Booth Four: 'Guest unattended between 11:00 PM and 12:35 AM. Table sat empty with half-melted ice.'

evidence.name: Coroner & Ballistics Report
evidence.description: Frankie Morretti died instantly at approximately 11:45 PM from a .38 caliber slug fired at close range.

evidence.name: Lab Analysis: Silk Cuff Stain
evidence.description: Chemical analysis of black grime on Vance's jacket sleeve: Heavy mineral machinery grease identical to lubricants used on North Dock freight cranes.

evidence.name: Tire Tread Plaster Cast
evidence.description: Fresh tire impressions recovered from dock mud at 11:55 PM match Firestone Deluxe Champions fitted to Vance's 1948 Packard sedan.

contradictions.description: Cash payment claim conflicts with signed card receipt
contradictions.why_it_conflicts: Vance claims he paid for everything in green cash, but Evidence E1 shows a signed credit card transaction timestamped 10:45 PM.

contradictions.description: Continuous booth presence conflicts with empty table log
contradictions.why_it_conflicts: Vance claims he never left Booth Four for even a single minute, yet Evidence E2 proves Booth Four was empty between 11:00 PM and 12:35 AM.

contradictions.description: Clean night at club conflicts with industrial dock grease on silk cuff
contradictions.why_it_conflicts: Vance claims he never visited any docks or industrial areas, but Evidence E4 proves heavy freight crane grease on his jacket cuff.

contradictions.description: Never left club conflicts with Packard tire tracks at murder docks
contradictions.why_it_conflicts: Vance claims he and his car stayed parked outside the Blue Note all night, but Evidence E5 proves his Packard's tires left fresh tracks in dock mud at 11:55 PM.

contradictions.description: Claim of no involvement or knowledge of firearms conflicts with coroner .38 caliber findings
contradictions.why_it_conflicts: Vance claims he abhors violence and has never touched a firearm, but ballistics in E3 show an execution with a .38 weapon.
